title: Values in the unrolled circuit
statement: Let $M$ be a sequential Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and $r$ registers, let $T$ be a nonnegative integer, and fix an input assignment $x\colon\{0,\ldots,n-1\}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. For every $k\le T$ and every vertex index $a<n+r+g$, where $g$ is the number of gates in the combinational part, the value at the vertex assigned by the unrolling to index $a$ at time $k$ equals the value at index $a$ of the combinational circuit evaluated on the concatenation of $x$ and the state of $M$ at time $k$.
hypotheses_covered: An input assignment $x$ to the $n$ inputs
